run.name: Viasat Inc
run.title: CP-OS host session (VSAT)
run.summary: Viasat has deleveraged and holds ample liquidity, but operating income falls well short of interest expense, spending is heavy, and a USD 600.0 million secured-note maturity falls due by mid-2027. The credit view is adequate but exposed. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context; the EDGAR registrant name in that context is VIASAT INC.

revenue.basis: Total revenues, as the CP-1 table prints it.

ebitda.basis: Derived EBITDA, as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Debt principal and cash at June 30, 2026 over derived EBITDA for the twelve months ended June 30, 2026 (FY2026 plus Q1 FY2027 less Q1 FY2026); consolidated across the Viasat and Inmarsat groups; not a covenant ratio

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. Derived EBITDA over LTM cash interest of USD 303.7 million (FY2026 plus Q1 FY2027 less Q1 FY2026, the two quarters taken from MD&A text rounded to USD 0.1 million); not a covenant ratio

cash.basis: Cash. Cash and cash equivalents; undrawn is 600.3 (647.5 less 47.2 letters of credit) plus 550.0; the Inmarsat revolver matures March 28, 2027 and the Viasat revolver can mature early on its springing date; group location of the cash is not supplied

cashflow.basis: Net cash from operating activities, as the CP-1 table prints it.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Derived EBITDA only, no covenant levels, no group-level data, and ownership and ratings are not supplied.
CP-1 main limitation: EBITDA is derived from filed lines, not company-defined, and covenant levels are not printed.
